scripts.build:dev: cp .env.dev .env && vite build && rm -rf dist-dev && cp -r dist dist-dev && node -e "const f='dist-dev/manifest.json';const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f));m.name='Wikipedia Breadcrumbs (Dev)';m.version='1.0';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2))"
scripts.build:prod: cp .env.prod .env && vite build && rm -rf dist-prod && cp -r dist dist-prod && node -e "const f='dist-prod/manifest.json';const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f));m.name='Wikipedia Breadcrumbs';m.version='0.9';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2))"
